runtime_id.description: Opaque identity of the current runtime incarnation, such as the systemd InvocationID. Adapters advertising restart must supply it while running; it changes after a completed restart. A controller binding game readiness to a unit start (server.start) requires it from the inspection after that start and fails closed without it.

target.description: Exact host binding, required with release_ref and runtime_id when the adapter advertises restart.
